supportFolders._catalog: Catalog validator and its tests; not a template.
supportFolders._fitted-core: Shared Blender core, wrapper, synthetic fixtures and STL inspector for the fitted templates; not a template.

parameterFields.name: Parameter key as the template consumes it (argparse dest or FitSpec key).
parameterFields.type: number | integer | enum | interval (FitSpec {nominalMm, lowerMm, upperMm}).
parameterFields.units: mm, fraction (of object height), count, or null.
parameterFields.default: CLI default, or the contract fixture value for FitSpec templates.
parameterFields.min: Lower bound or null; inclusive unless exclusiveMin is true.
parameterFields.max: Upper bound or null; inclusive unless exclusiveMax is true.

templates.name: Cup-holder adapter
templates.summary: Tapered insert for a car cup holder with a cradle ring for a wider cup; surface of revolution.

parameters.name: holderInnerBottomDiameter
parameters.description: Holder inside diameter at its floor; the lower bound caps the insert outside.

parameters.name: holderInnerTopDiameter
parameters.description: Holder inside diameter at its rim; the lower bound sets the insert top and the rim opening.

parameters.name: insertionDepth
parameters.description: Holder depth; the insert length is the lower bound.

parameters.name: cupOuterDiameter
parameters.description: Cup outside diameter; the cradle inside uses the upper bound plus clearance.

parameters.name: cupSupportHeight
parameters.description: Cradle height above the holder rim, nominal; must exceed wallThickness.

parameters.name: wallThickness
parameters.description: Insert, floor and cradle wall thickness, nominal.

parameters.name: radialClearance
parameters.description: Radial clearance, consumed at its upper bound on insert and cradle.

templates.name: Drawer organizer tray
templates.summary: Open rectangular tray with perimeter walls and a uniform divider grid sized to a drawer.

parameters.name: drawerInnerWidth
parameters.description: Drawer inside width (X); tray outside uses the lower bound minus clearance.

parameters.name: drawerInnerDepth
parameters.description: Drawer inside depth (Y); tray outside uses the lower bound minus clearance.

parameters.name: drawerInnerHeight
parameters.description: Lowest drawer obstruction; trayHeight upper bound must fit below its lower bound.

parameters.name: wallThickness
parameters.description: Perimeter wall and divider thickness, nominal.

parameters.name: floorThickness
parameters.description: Tray floor thickness, nominal.

parameters.name: peripheralClearance
parameters.description: Gap to the drawer on each side, consumed at its upper bound.

parameters.name: trayHeight
parameters.description: Tray outside height, nominal; dividers stop 2 mm below it.

parameters.name: dividersAcross
parameters.description: Dividers splitting the width; every cell keeps at least 10 mm clear span.

parameters.name: dividersAlong
parameters.description: Dividers splitting the depth; every cell keeps at least 10 mm clear span.

templates.name: Scan cradle
templates.summary: Open stand with an object-derived pocket and a straight +Z lift-out path.

parameters.name: clearance_mm
parameters.description: Minimum geometric offset between object and pocket.

parameters.name: wall_mm
parameters.description: Floor and side wall minimum.

parameters.name: seat_depth
parameters.description: Seat line as a fraction of object height.

parameters.name: margin_mm
parameters.description: Base beyond object bounds plus clearance, each side; must be at least wall_mm + 2 * grid_mm.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Source axis that becomes output +Z.

parameters.name: grid_mm
parameters.description: XY voxel-column step; at most 512 cells per axis and 200000 in total.

parameters.name: notch_side
parameters.description: Optional cable trench through one side, down to floor level.

parameters.name: notch_position_mm
parameters.description: Notch centre along its side; must not remove corner walls.

parameters.name: notch_width_mm
parameters.description: Requested notch width; grid conservatism enlarges it.

templates.name: Wall mount holder
templates.summary: Open-top pocket fused to a screw-on back plate; the object drops in from above.

parameters.name: clearance_mm
parameters.description: Minimum gap between object and every pocket surface.

parameters.name: wall_mm
parameters.description: Minimum pocket side wall; at least 2 * grid_mm; rounded up to the grid.

parameters.name: floor_mm
parameters.description: Pocket floor thickness, exact.

parameters.name: hold_depth
parameters.description: Cup wall top as a fraction of object height.

parameters.name: plate_mm
parameters.description: Back plate thickness; rounded up to the grid.

parameters.name: plate_extension_mm
parameters.description: Plate height above the cup top, holding the screw holes; at least screw_hole_mm + 2 * wall_mm.

parameters.name: screw_hole_mm
parameters.description: Screw clearance diameter; holes contain this disc.

parameters.name: screw_spacing_mm
parameters.description: Centre-to-centre spacing of the two holes along X; at least screw_hole_mm + 2 * wall_mm; the plate widens to fit.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Source axis that becomes output +Z (insertion axis).

parameters.name: grid_mm
parameters.description: XY cell size; at most 1024 cells per axis and 400000 in total.

templates.name: Protective sleeve
templates.summary: Open-top conformal bumper with a configurable clearance and solid floor.

parameters.name: clearance_mm
parameters.description: Minimum gap between object and every sleeve surface.

parameters.name: wall_mm
parameters.description: Minimum conformal wall thickness; at least 2 * grid_mm; up to one grid cell thicker.

parameters.name: floor_mm
parameters.description: Sleeve floor thickness, exact.

parameters.name: coverage
parameters.description: Sleeve top as a fraction of object height.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Source axis that becomes output +Z (insertion axis).

parameters.name: grid_mm
parameters.description: XY cell size; at most 1024 cells per axis and 400000 in total.

templates.name: Desk or shelf edge clip holder
templates.summary: Open-top pocket on a C-clamp that slides onto a desk or shelf edge of configurable thickness.

parameters.name: clearance_mm
parameters.description: Minimum gap between object and every pocket surface.

parameters.name: wall_mm
parameters.description: Minimum pocket side wall; at least 2 * grid_mm; rounded up to the grid.

parameters.name: hold_depth
parameters.description: Cup wall top as a fraction of object height.

parameters.name: edge_thickness_mm
parameters.description: Thickness of the desk or shelf edge.

parameters.name: edge_clearance_mm
parameters.description: Added to edge thickness to give the exact slot height.

parameters.name: grip_depth_mm
parameters.description: How far the jaws reach over the edge; rounded up to the grid.

parameters.name: jaw_mm
parameters.description: Jaw thickness (exact; the upper jaw is the pocket floor) and spine thickness (rounded up to the grid).

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Source axis that becomes output +Z (insertion axis).

parameters.name: grid_mm
parameters.description: XY cell size; at most 1024 cells per axis and 400000 in total.
